verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is Greenhouse's structured scorecard questions, which AI-generated interview notes map onto, and a structured voice interview offered as an alternative to resume screening. Together these give thin support for the structured-feedback part of the story. Nothing documents demographic-blind review, and the reporting evidence covers general recruiting dimensions rather than DEI funnel reporting. Missing for 10: feedback-ordering controls (e.g., hiding others' feedback until an interviewer submits), demographic-blind or anonymized review options, DEI/EEOC funnel reporting, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an operations lead, the platform helps reduce bias — structured feedback ordering, demographic-blind review options, and DEI reporting on the funnel

citations.quote: instantly maps AI-generated notes directly to scorecard questions for clear feedback
replacing the resume lottery with a structured voice interview
